name: gdpr-ai-act
display_name: GDPR & EU AI Act — Data Protection & Artificial Intelligence
description: Structured knowledge graph for GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) and the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689). Covers lawful processing bases, data subject rights, DPO, DPIA, cross-border transfers, AI risk classification, prohibited AI, high-risk AI system requirements, GPAI models, and conformity assessment. Cross-references to AML, DORA and CSRD.
author: Futurechain FCP Team
